documents.t: sdv-py LKL: endpoint references, dataset loaders and parsers for LKL in the SportsDataverse Python package.
LKL — LKL site API (lkl.lt, Lithuania) — endpoint reference in sdv-py, the SportsDataverse Python package.
Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.basketball.lkl — 14 endpoints. Note: Unofficial and unsupported: these are the routes lkl.lt's own game page calls (found in its front-end bundle) and its server-rendered pages. The site's robots.txt allows everything and sets no crawl-delay; lkl_runtime still spaces requests at least 1 s apart. SportsDataverse has not ruled on the site's terms, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Note: Coverage: game wrappers serve FINISHED games only (an unfinished game raises AssetFetchError). The box score, summary, score line, statistics and leaders answer for every season from 1993-94 (before 2024-25 the scoring splits and lead statistics are 0). Play-by-play and shots exist from 2024-25 only; an earlier finished game raises NoDataError. From 2016-17 the results season id is also the Genius LiveStats competition id (see the genius family) which holds play-by-play for older games; lkl.lt game, team and player ids are lkl.lt's own and do not join Genius ids. The King Mindaugas Cup shares the routes but is not wrapped. Text fields are Lithuanian.
